text:
olivia: Kicking off regional shift for /generate -> v2 in eu-west at 02:00 UTC. Plan: 5% -> 15% -> 50% over 30m with 5m probes. Change window 30m. @kevin @anika please monitor.

 deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout v2 -> router weight config. Job: roll/2345. ETA: ~60s. Links: https://ci/redwood/roll/2345

 kevin: copying notes from runbook — ensure warm pool >= 3 replicas before 15%.

 marcus: warm nodes currently 1/3; scaling triggered but warm-up thermal delays ~90s on N1-GPU.

 anika: re: session affinity, recommend `session_pin: none` for this shift to avoid hot keys.

 olivia: ok leaving pin off. the plan includes KV cache warm on v2, but cache miss rate expected to spike.

 sre-oncall: seeing 12% 95th latency increase on edge-proxy with 10% traffic. CPU up on router-2.

 kevin: can we slow the ramp? hold at 5% and let warm pools reach 3.

 olivia: holding at 5% now. deploy-bot: update

 deploy-bot: Traffic update: /generate weight set to 5% -> v2 (effective). roll/2345 paused for manual approval.

 marcus: uploading quick snapshot: `curl https://metrics/api?q=latency&range=5m` -> 95p=860ms now, baseline 680ms.

 anika: suggest reduce per-route concurrency to 50 on v2 to avoid bursty queuing.

 kevin: applying router tweak:
 ```
 redwoodctl router update --route /generate --backend v2 --concurrency 50
 ```

 deploy-bot: Router config applied by kevin. Commit: cfg/9876

 sre-oncall: latency dipping back to 720ms after concurrency change.

 olivia: good. plan: keep at 5% for 15m, then probe 15% if stable. If P95 > 800ms -> rollback to v1 and pin weight 100%.

 anika: noted. I'll prepare a release note blurb about KV cold-cache risk and mitigations.

 kevin: also adding a post-rollback job in case we need it: `rollout cancel roll/2345 && router pin --route /generate --backend v1`

 olivia: agreed. keeping this thread as the coordination channel. ping if anything happens. :thumbsup:

 deploy-bot: Reminder: change window ends in 28m. Auto-rollback threshold: p95_latency > 800ms for 5m.

 marcus: monitoring dashboards, will call oncall if error rate crosses 0.5%.

 sre-oncall: all good so far at 5% after 9m. no error uptick.

 olivia: proceeding to probe 15% in 3m if no regressions. everyone stand by.

 kevin: ack

 anika: ack

 marcus: ack
